description: The classifier's verb (spirit/test/scriptClassify.js): a production script's class, set on its row in testicle.db's script table. browserOnly, the script loads in a page and not on the node; nodeOnly, on the node and not in a page; both false, it runs on both; both true says nothing and is refused (bad-request). Its reClassify is cleared, unless a classifying run under way started on other bytes of the script, so the next run takes it again. Answers the script row, {name, hash, deleted, changed, reClassify, browserOnly, nodeOnly}. A name that is no script (not a .js, outside run://, or ignored) answers "not a production script"; a script with no row, "no such file".
